n9f3442fcc6b.s: Which of the following is an ICMR-related initiative?
n9f3442fcc6b.x: The India TB Research Consortium is listed among ICMR initiatives, with MERA India and the India Hypertension Control Initiative. India Food Security Consortium is not an ICMR initiative; Eat Right India is FSSAI's and U-WIN is the immunisation registry.

n3a9dea37da5.s: Which pillar of Ayushman Bharat provides comprehensive primary care?
n3a9dea37da5.x: Ayushman Arogya Mandirs provide comprehensive primary care. PM-JAY is the hospitalisation assurance pillar, ABDM the digital backbone and PM-ABHIM the health infrastructure pillar.

n6a708df8395.s: The Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission is implemented by:
n6a708df8395.x: ABDM, launched in September 2021, is implemented by the National Health Authority, not NITI Aayog.

n85bb96a0293.s: Anaemia Mukt Bharat was launched in:
n85bb96a0293.x: Anaemia Mukt Bharat was launched in 2018 and follows the 6x6x6 strategy; 2014 is wrong.

ne26fdaabecf.s: In Andhra Pradesh, telemedicine services are available in:
o: Only private hospitals empanelled under PM-JAY
None of the Ayushman Arogya Mandirs
ne26fdaabecf.x: Telemedicine is available in all Ayushman Arogya Mandirs in Andhra Pradesh (APPSC 2024); it is not confined to AIIMS Mangalagiri or empanelled private hospitals.

n93e7feabd40.s: India switched from trivalent to bivalent oral polio vaccine in:
n93e7feabd40.x: The switch from tOPV to bOPV took place in April 2016, not 2014; March 2014 is when SEAR was certified polio-free.

nddb8b1f7bb1.s: NACP Phase V (2021-26) aims at what cut in new HIV infections and AIDS deaths?
nddb8b1f7bb1.x: NACP Phase V (2021-26) aims at an 80% cut in new infections and AIDS deaths, not 50%.

n2f693a5e00c.s: The third '95' of the UNAIDS 95-95-95 target refers to:
o: People living with HIV knowing their status
Those who know their status being on treatment
Suppressed viral load among those on treatment
n2f693a5e00c.x: The three 95s are: know status, be on treatment, and have a suppressed viral load; the third is viral suppression among those on treatment.

n8cfb557e619.s: Which of the following is NOT correct about the expanded NP-NCD in Andhra Pradesh?
o: It covers mental health and elderly care
It provides free leprosy MDT in place of NLEP
It covers Iodine Deficiency Disorders and tobacco control
It covers fluorosis and oral health
n8cfb557e619.x: AP's expanded NP-NCD covers mental health, elderly care, IDD, tobacco control, fluorosis and oral health. Free leprosy MDT is given under NLEP, not NP-NCD.

n2f338851349.s: The reported mental-health treatment gap in India is about:
n2f338851349.x: The treatment gap is 84.5%, with about one in seven Indians affected and 0.3 psychiatrists per lakh population.

n5dc4a97f224.s: Free multidrug therapy (MDT) for leprosy at PHCs is provided under:
n5dc4a97f224.x: Free MDT for leprosy at PHCs is under the National Leprosy Eradication Programme (with the Sparsh campaign), not NVBDCP.

new.s: Under the National Health Policy, 2017, public health spending was targeted at what share of GDP by 2025?
new.x: NHP 2017 targeted public health spending of 2.5% of GDP by 2025; it was missed, at 1.43% in 2022-23.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the National Health Policy, 2017 targets:
1. Total fertility rate of 2.1 by 2025.
2. Public health spending of 1.43% of GDP by 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: NHP 2017 set a TFR of 2.1 by 2025. Its spending target was 2.5% of GDP; 1.43% is the level actually reached in 2022-23.

new.s: Which National Health Mission scheme gives cash assistance for institutional delivery?
new.x: Janani Suraksha Yojana gives cash for institutional delivery and is 100% centrally sponsored; JSSK gives free, zero-expense delivery.

new.s: Under the National Health Mission, the Centre–State funding ratio for North-Eastern and Himalayan States is:
new.x: NHM funding is usually 60:40, but 90:10 for North-Eastern and Himalayan States.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Mobile Academy – Weekly audio messages to mothers
new.x: JSY gives cash for institutional delivery. JSSK gives free delivery, RKSK covers adolescents of 10–19 years, and Mobile Academy is an audio course for ASHAs (Kilkari sends messages to mothers).

new.s: Under the Universal Immunisation Programme, the pneumococcal conjugate vaccine (PCV) primary doses are given at:
new.x: PCV is given at 6 and 14 weeks, with a booster at 9-12 months.

new.s: Under the UIP schedule, Td (tetanus and adult diphtheria) is given at:
new.x: Td is given at 10 and 16 years; at 5–6 years it is DPT booster-2, a common trap.

new.s: U-WIN is a digital registry for:
o: Routine immunisation of pregnant women and children
new.x: U-WIN is the digital registry of routine immunisation for pregnant women and children.

new.s: Mission Indradhanush, launched in December 2014, mainly reaches:
new.x: Mission Indradhanush is a catch-up drive under UIP for zero-dose and partly immunised children, targeting 90% full immunisation.

new.s: PM-ABHIM was launched on 25 October 2021 at:
new.x: The Prime Minister launched PM-ABHIM at Varanasi on 25 October 2021.

new.s: The outlay of PM-ABHIM (2021-22 to 2025-26) is:
new.x: PM-ABHIM has an outlay of ₹64,180 crore, the largest pan-India health infrastructure scheme.

new.s: The target for Ayushman Arogya Mandirs (earlier AB-HWCs) was:
new.x: The target was 1,50,000; over 1.73 lakh have been converted.

new.s: eSanjeevani, now equipped with a Clinical Decision Support System, is a:
new.x: eSanjeevani is a telemedicine service, now with a Clinical Decision Support System.

new.s: Arogya Mitra, sometimes confused with ABDM components, actually belongs to:
new.x: Arogya Mitra is the PM-JAY hospital facilitator, not a component of ABDM.

new.s: Which ABDM component is meant for testing?
new.x: The Sandbox is ABDM's testing component; UHI and the Consent Manager are gateways and the Drug Registry is a registry.

new.s: The Fit India Movement was launched in:
new.x: Fit India Movement began in 2019 to bring fitness into daily life; Swachh Bharat was 2014 and Eat Right India 2018.

new.s: FSSAI, which runs Eat Right India, was created under the:
new.x: FSSAI was created under the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

new.s: How many pillars does ICMR's Strategic Plan 2017-24 ('Vision 2030') have?
new.x: Vision 2030 has 5 pillars and 15 goals.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a pillar of ICMR's 'Vision 2030' strategic plan?
new.x: The five pillars are capacity building, data management, leveraging traditional medicine, evidence to policy, and strengthening programme implementation through research; health insurance is not one.

new.s: The Indian Research Fund Association was renamed ICMR in:
new.x: IRFA, set up in 1911, was renamed ICMR in 1949.

new.s: Who is the Director-General of the World Health Organization?
new.x: Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus is WHO Director-General; his second term ends on 15 August 2027.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the World Health Organization:
1. Its headquarters is at Geneva.
2. Its membership reached 194 in 2013.
3. The second term of its Director-General ends in 2025.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: WHO is at Geneva and has had 194 members since 2013. Tedros's second term ends on 15 August 2027, not 2025.

new.s: The theme of World Health Day 2026 is:
o: Together for health. Stand with science
new.x: World Health Day 2026 theme is 'Together for health. Stand with science'.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's Family Physician programme was launched on 6 April 2023 at:
new.x: The Family Doctor programme was launched on 6 April 2023 at Lingamguntla, Chilakaluripet mandal (Palnadu).

new.s: Under AP's Family Physician programme, doctors give preventive care through about how many YSR Village Health Clinics?
new.x: Doctors work through 10,032 YSR Village Health Clinics; 42,060 is the number of ASHAs in AP.

new.s: In September 2026, Critical Care Blocks and IPHLs under PM-ABHIM in Andhra Pradesh were inaugurated from:
new.x: J.P. Nadda inaugurated 10 Critical Care Blocks and 12 IPHLs (₹250 crore) from Vijayawada.

new.s: In HIV services, ICTC stands for:
new.x: ICTC is the Integrated Counselling and Testing Centre, offering free, voluntary testing with counselling.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Red Ribbon Express – HIV/AIDS awareness train
new.x: The Red Ribbon Express is an awareness train. AVAHAN is a Gates Foundation prevention initiative, ELISA is a screening test (no HIV vaccine is licensed) and Zidovudine is an anti-retroviral drug.

new.s: The National AIDS Control Programme was launched in:
new.x: NACP was launched in 1992 and is led by NACO under MoHFW; 1981 is when HIV was first recognised.

new.s: The first WHO-approved malaria vaccine, RTS,S/AS01 (Mosquirix), was developed by:
new.x: Mosquirix is by GSK; R21/Matrix-M is by Oxford's Jenner Institute with the Serum Institute.

new.s: The R21/Matrix-M malaria vaccine was developed by:
o: Oxford Jenner Institute and Serum Institute of India
new.x: R21/Matrix-M was developed by Oxford's Jenner Institute with the Serum Institute of India.

new.s: MERA India, the Malaria Elimination Research Alliance India, is led by:
new.x: MERA India is led by ICMR.

new.s: India was declared smallpox-free in:
new.x: India became smallpox-free in 1977; polio certification came in 2014 – do not swap the years.

new.s: Which of the following pairs is INCORRECTLY matched?
new.x: India became smallpox-free in 1977; 2014 is the polio-free certification year.

new.s: India's last wild polio case was reported in January 2011 from:
new.x: The last wild polio case was from Howrah, West Bengal, in January 2011.

new.s: The Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana provides:
o: Nutritional DBT to notified TB patients
Adoption of TB patients by Ni-kshay Mitras
new.x: Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana gives nutritional DBT to all notified TB patients, public and private.

new.s: Under the PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan (September 2022), TB patients are adopted by:
new.x: Under PM TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, Ni-kshay Mitras adopt TB patients.

new.s: During 2015-2024, TB treatment coverage in India rose from 53% to:
new.x: Treatment coverage rose from 53% to 92%; treatment success reached 90% in 2025.

new.s: Anti-Leprosy Day in India is observed on:
new.x: Anti-Leprosy Day is 30 January (Gandhi's death anniversary); World Leprosy Day is the last Sunday of January.

new.s: The National Sickle Cell Anaemia Elimination Mission was launched on 1 July 2023 at:
new.x: It was launched on 1 July 2023 at Shahdol, Madhya Pradesh, with a tribal focus.

new.s: The target year for eliminating measles-rubella in India is:
new.x: Measles-rubella elimination is targeted for 2026; lymphatic filariasis is 2027 and malaria 2030.

new.s: India's target year for eliminating lymphatic filariasis is:
new.x: Lymphatic filariasis elimination is targeted for 2027, three years ahead of the SDG.

new.s: The kala-azar elimination target of less than one case per 10,000 in every block was achieved in:
new.x: The kala-azar target was achieved in 2023; WHO certification is pending.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about nutrition-related programmes:
1. The National Goitre Control Programme was launched in 1962.
2. Vitamin A prophylaxis against nutritional blindness began in 1992.
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The Goitre programme began in 1962. Vitamin A prophylaxis began in 1970; 1992 is when the Goitre programme was renamed NIDDCP.

new.s: The National Goitre Control Programme was renamed the National Iodine Deficiency Disorders Control Programme in:
new.x: It was renamed NIDDCP in 1992.

new.s: The Vitamin A prophylaxis programme against nutritional blindness began in:
new.x: Vitamin A prophylaxis against nutritional blindness began in 1970.

new.s: Which of the following is NOT a nutrition-related programme?
new.x: IDD and Vitamin A programmes are nutrition programmes; NLEP is a disease (leprosy) programme.

new.s: NP-NCD was earlier known as:
new.x: NP-NCD was earlier NPCDCS; it uses population-based screening to find high-risk people and link them to care.

new.s: The HPV vaccine Cervavac, targeting cervical cancer, was developed by:
new.x: Cervavac is India's first indigenous quadrivalent HPV vaccine, made by the Serum Institute for cervical cancer.

new.s: The main approach of NP-NCD is:
o: Population-based screening to find high-risk people
new.x: NP-NCD uses population-based screening to identify high-risk people and link them to care.

new.s: India's first mental health programme, the NMHP, was launched in:
new.x: NMHP began in 1982; the Mental Health Act came in 1987 and Tele-MANAS in 2022.

new.s:
Consider the following statements about the Mental Healthcare Act, 2017:
1. It decriminalised suicide.
2. It repealed the Mental Health Act, 1987.
3. It restricted electroconvulsive therapy (ECT).
Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
new.x: The 2017 Act decriminalised suicide, restricted ECT, gave a right to access government care and repealed the 1987 Act.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh notified over how many TB cases in 2024?
new.x: AP notified over 78,000 TB cases in 2024.

new.s: What is the target month for Andhra Pradesh's HIV goals?
new.x: AP's HIV cascade stood at 88%/87%/96.2% in August 2026, with the target set for December 2026.

new.s: World TB Day is observed on:
new.x: World TB Day is 24 March; World Alzheimer's Day is 21 September and World AIDS Day 1 December.
